coverage: 维基页写 December 1689，题名页 marked 1690。同页也写 published anonymously in 1689。没有出版日。
excerpt: Two Treatises was first published, anonymously, in December 1689 (following printing conventions of the time, its title page was marked 1690).
limitation: date=unknown。December 1689 只有月。题名页年份 1690 与问世月不是同一个日期。本TXT题名页另印 MDCLXXXVIII（1688），数字化说明写 1690。不把三者收成一个日。

coverage: 页内写 currently 193 UN Member States，以及 as at August 2026。没有日。
excerpt: There are currently 193 UN Member States.
limitation: date=unknown。August 2026 没有日，不补成某日。193 是会员国数目，用来对照洛克所说独立政府的统治者仍有一批人，不是个人自然状态的普查。

coverage: 页内有 Old Sarum 选民不超过十一人仍返回议员，1832年改革取消56个自治市，以及铭文 7th June 1832。网页自己的出版日没有写出。
excerpt: very few voters resided, yet two MPs were still returned to the House of Commons at each election.
limitation: date=unknown。7 June 1832 是页内铭文上的取消日，不是这篇网页的出版日，也不当作观察窗口的终点。

coverage: 连续句写 Dunwich 因海岸侵蚀衰落，并写 Manchester 为兴盛的城市中心。同页后文写 Old Sarum 从 once-flourishing city 变成 deserted。
excerpt: In some cases, they were settlements which had once been much larger, but which had dramatically declined, perhaps through migration or (famously in the case of Dunwich in Suffolk) by coastal erosion. Even when this happened, the constituency retained its ancient borough status, returning the same number of representatives as booming urban and industrial centres like Manchester.
limitation: date=unknown。网页没有自己的出版日。这条摘录是城市兴废，不借用返回两名议员的定义句。
